label: 0023 · Smoothed in time (one QP over all windows): linked coupling + afterslip states, correlated noise, cross-validated, Boso SSEs removed, UNR positions (MAP)
description: One QP over all 25 windows of the Boso pilot (0021 with the Boso SSEs removed): background coupling linked through the whole record (departures of 0.1 over 5 yr, never reset) plus afterslip states for Tohoku (trench and BEL, one pattern on a decaying envelope), the 2005 and 2021 Miyagi-oki, Noto and Hyuga-nada earthquakes. Noise correlated within each window (1.4 × the window σ over 150 km) and all scales tuned by cross-validation, so coupling shows only what persists and residuals hold the window-specific signal. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
attribution: GNSS: GEONET daily positions, Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI).
